results.title: Por el camino de en medio
results.original_title: Por el camino de en medio
results.overview: A middle-aged man in Carabanchel struggles with precarious work, debt and bureaucracy. After his mother dies, an unexpected turn pushes him to challenge the rules that have trapped him.

results.title: My Husband's Other Wife
results.overview: A grieving widow's world unravels as she discovers shocking truths about her late husband's hidden life, plunging her into a dangerous web of deception and mystery.

results.title: To Love A Monster
results.overview: After being set up on his first date ever, a romance-obsessed monster must tame his grotesque features or risk losing his last chance at love.

results.title: Irul Inithu (Mirk)
results.overview: Selvam and Shyamala who is living in the city has a long time dream of building a small and simple house  of their own. Real estate broker Kannaiya assists them in buying a plot in the suburbs while scheming his  own plot. The story revolves around the fate of Selvam and Shyamala's dream home.

results.title: No me quiero ir de aquí: Una más
results.original_title: No me quiero ir de aquí: Una más
results.overview: Watch Bad Bunny live from San Juan, Puerto Rico and celebrate the music, culture, and community that makes Puerto Rico unforgettable.

results.title: Kidney Trial
results.overview: “Death does not have enough time to kill everyone, so he chose the doctors as his messengers” (R. Nachman). The Breslov branch of Hasidic Judaism, to which the young couple Nati and Dana belong, identifies with this saying. However, when their daughter Tehila suffers from kidney failure, Dana is forced to embark on a journey to find a cure for her daughter, choosing between relying solely on her faith or betraying everything she believes in to listen to the voices of science, technology, and medicine, which are completely foreign to her world.

results.title: Foreign Exchange
results.overview: A former escort who once “traveled the world” through his lovers, finally discovers true love. But when past clients reenter his life, he must confront old temptations and the challenges of loyalty, desire, and commitment.

results.title: Before After
results.overview: Jan wants to film, Frank wants to be filmed. This needs to be set up and discussed.

results.title: Narcolepsy
results.overview: Ben is narcoleptic, suffering from an illness he can’t shake off, one that alters his memories and perception of everyday life. Isolated from the rest of the world, his lonely existence is governed by his paranoia toward his downstairs neighbor, Eric. And when, through his floor, he hears a young woman screaming, Ben is drawn into a cat-and-mouse game, teetering between illusion and reality, in search of answers.

results.title: The Profumo Affair: Stephen Thrower on "The Perfume of the Lady in Black"
results.original_title: The Profumo Affair: Stephen Thrower on "The Perfume of the Lady in Black"
results.overview: Author Stephen Thrower talks in detail about the Italian 1970s thriller classic "The Perfume of the Lady in Black".

results.title: Yet Another Family Drama
results.overview: An estranged son gets an unexpected visit from his mother. As old conflicts are reignited, their flames become a fascinating show for a stranger, who just happens to have spent the night over.

results.title: The Christmas Bookshop
results.overview: A holiday expert and a bookstore owner go head-to-head in a festive bet to prove whose approach to Christmas is best, only to find that love and compromise might be the real holiday magic.

results.title: Phoenix Rising -In the Moonlight-
results.overview: The PHOENIX, portrayed by Moon Troupe’s top star An Hozuki, rides upon the winds after his resurrection under the full moon and visits various countries in Asia, bringing happiness to people. This dynamic revue promises to showcase the most beloved elements of a Takarazuka performance.

results.title: The Last Summer
results.overview: With the college entrance examination approaching, top student Li Zhizhi accidentally hits a girl playing downstairs with a falling object. Facing her family's eager expectations, Li Zhizhi choses to conceal the incident. Unexpectedly, her parents already know about the incidient. The three members of the family keep it a secret from each other, turning the accident into ridiculous farce.

results.title: The Invalids
results.overview: In a dystopian future where disability is exploited for sport, two disabled women wake up trapped in a brutal competition - to survive, they must outwit a system built to erase them.

results.title: Lemonade Blessing
results.overview: Freshly tossed into private Catholic high school by his recently divorced mother, John must go from good boy to heinous sinner when he falls for a girl who requires him to commit sacrilegious acts in order to further their relationship.

results.title: The Four Bad Boys and Me
results.original_title: The Four Bad Boys and Me
results.overview: A nerdy, weird, and forever-alone nobody's supposedly 'peaceful' life undergoes a chaotic change when she unexpectedly gets tangled with a group of four notorious bad boys.

results.title: Amnion
results.overview: The amnion – the fetal membrane protecting the embryo – becomes a metaphor in the film for an intimate space where pain can be shared and a path to healing sought. This sensitive portrait of three women whose lives have been marked by sudden separation is carried from the outset by a meditative soundtrack that shapes an environment in which personal experience becomes expressible. Ritual gestures – traditional costumes, cooking together, hugging – create a protective shell that allows pain not only to be expressed and shared, but also transformed.

results.title: Bury Your Nephew
results.overview: An uncle struggling to find common ground with his broody nephew eventually bonds with him over a dark curiosity.
